source.note: DrugBank full database export; licensed data, not in the repo

model.description: v3: random forest on 12 graph and Node2Vec features plus 8 attribute features (structure, protein family, categories, ATC, chemical class)

attribution: Interaction data from DrugBank 5.1, used under CC BY-NC 4.0 for non-commercial purposes.
contents: model outputs, public identifiers and each drug's known targets (UniProt accession and gene symbol)
score_note: Calibrated (per model copy) on validation pairs with one non-interaction per interaction; a ranking signal, not the chance an interaction is real. score_tied marks scores that round to the same two decimals as another shown candidate.
